articles.title: High Chair Footrest Importance: Why Proper Positioning Matters
articles.author: Tayla White
articles.summary_html: Most parents overlook the importance of footrest positioning in high chairs, yet this small adjustment has a major impact on safety, posture, and eating success. Proper foot support follows the 90-90-90 rule, giving children a stable base that improves digestion, reduces choking risk, and boosts concentration during meals. Backed by pediatric occupational therapy research, this guide explains the science of foot support, how to measure and adjust footrests at each stage of growth, and which high chairs and accessories ensure optimal alignment for your child’s development.

image.alt: adjustable wooden high chair with footrest for toddlers

articles.title: Wooden vs Plastic High Chairs: Durability, Safety & Style Compared
articles.author: Valentine Okpala
articles.summary_html: Parents choosing between wooden and plastic high chairs face a balance of durability, safety, style, and budget. Wooden high chairs last 15–20+ years, provide heirloom quality, and blend seamlessly with home décor, while plastic high chairs excel in portability, easy cleaning, and affordability. This guide compares material lifespan, safety standards, maintenance needs, and environmental impact to help you make the best choice for your family’s lifestyle and mealtime setup.

articles.title: High Chair Safety: Recalls, Standards & What to Look For
articles.author: Tayla White
articles.summary_html: High chairs are essential for family mealtimes, but safety concerns make choosing the right one critical. With thousands of annual ER visits linked to high chair injuries, parents must look for JPMA certification, sturdy five-point harnesses, stable bases, and secure tray locks. Recent recalls in 2024–2025 affected major brands like Boyro Baby, Costway, and Bugaboo, highlighting the risks of uncertified models sold online. This guide explains key safety standards, recall patterns, must-have safety features, and showcases certified high chair options to help parents make informed, secure choices.

articles.title: Convertible High Chairs: From Infant to Adult - Worth the Investment?
articles.author: Tayla White
articles.summary_html: Convertible high chairs promise long-term savings, durability, and versatility—often replacing three or more separate seating solutions. While quality models cost £200–£500 upfront, they save families £400–£800 over five years, retain up to 60% resale value, and last 5–20+ years with proper care. Beyond cost, they reduce storage needs, support healthy posture at every stage, and offer sustainable design benefits. This guide compares convertible vs standard high chairs, breaks down ROI, and explores whether investing in a convertible high chair makes sense for your family.

articles.title: High Chair vs Booster Seat: When to Use Each & Transition Timeline
articles.author: Tayla White
articles.summary_html: Deciding between a high chair and a booster seat is one of the most important feeding milestones for growing toddlers. High chairs provide essential safety, full-body support, and adjustable features for babies from 6 months to 3 years, while booster seats are compact, portable, and perfect for toddlers 18 months to 5 years ready to join the family table. This guide breaks down timelines, readiness signs, pros and cons, and expert safety tips—helping parents navigate the transition smoothly while fostering independence and enjoyable mealtimes.
